Q) LTXX/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/3822N02559E357
A) LTBB LGGG B) 2611240700 C) 2611240900
E) NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNS:

THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO CLARIFY THE 'A4264/26' NOTAM ISSUED 
BY GREEK CAA. 
THE 'A4264/26' NOTAM ISSUED BY GREEK CAA CONSTITUES A BREACH OF 
GREECE'S TREATY OBLIGATIONS PERTAINING TO THE DEMILITARIZED STATUS 
OF EASTERN AEGEAN ISLANDS UNDER 'THE 1914 SIX POWER' DECISION 'THE 
1923 LAUSANNE PEACE TREATY'(WITH ITS ANNEX, THE CONVENTION RELATING 
TO THE REGIME OF THE STRAITS). COBAN (CASSOS) AND  KERPE (SCARPANTO) 
MENTIONED IN THE NOTAM AT REFERENCE HAS A DEMILITARISED STATUS . 
THUS COBAN (CASSOS) AND  KERPE (SCARPANTO) AND/OR HER TERRITORY 
MUST NOT BE INCLUDED IN ANY SCENERIO/CONCEPT OF ANY MILITARY 
TRAINING OR EXERCISE.
